name: King Khaled International Airport

runway.v: two parallel runways, 15L/33R and 15R/33L, each 4,205 m long and 60 m wide

slots.v: an IATA Level 3 (coordinated) airport; slot coordinator is Airport Coordination Limited (ACL). The page does not say how this applies to business aviation
slots.quote: King Khalid International Airport is designated as a Coordinated airport (Level 3)

hours.v: open 24 hours a day, every day of the year (as stated on the slot coordinator's airport page; not a customs-hours statement)
hours.quote: King Khalid International Airport is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, year round

permits.v: technical-stop flights are not permitted at Riyadh in the Winter 2026 and Summer 2027 seasons (parking stands reduced by rehabilitation works); training flights need Riyadh Airports Company approval
permits.quote: are not permitted at King Khalid International Airport during Winter 2026 & Summer 2027 seasons.

missing: curfew (no night-restriction statement found; '24 hours' is not an explicit 'no curfew')
